newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Sitt Tatt to buy stake in Chase Perdana.
newsitem.headline: Sitt Tatt to buy stake in Chase Perdana.

text.p: Sitt Tatt Bhd said on Tuesday it has agreed to acquire a 20 percent stake in Chase Perdana Bhd for 107.04 million ringgit in cash.
In a statement, Sitt Tatt said it will purchase 8.92 million shares in construction firm Chase Perdana from Melati Usaha Sdn Bhd and Trend Board Corp Sdn Bhd at 12 ringgit a share.
Chase Perdana stock closed at 10.40 ringgit on Tuesday.

Sitt Tatt said the proposed acquisition, to be financed through internally generated funds and borrowings, would enable it to be involved in the growing construction industry and diversify its earnings base.
Sitt Tatt makes and distributes industrial gases.
Sitt Tatt will emerge as Chase Perdana's single largest shareholder on completion of the acquisition, the statement said.
